• Technical and delivery lead for the 7-member Platform team behind GoTrack — the company's most active product, contributing 30% of ARR, serving enterprise clients like Honda, Unilever, TATA Motors, and Apollo Tyres.
  • Drove architecture and technical decision-making, enforced engineering best practices, and ensured scalable system design. Contributed to OKR and product planning, managed bandwidth and task allocation.
  • Improved engineering team velocity by reducing PR review SLAs to minutes via process changes (peer reviews, enforced review rotation) and introducing CodeRabbit for instant AI-based code reviews.
  • Spearheaded monolith to microservices migration, starting with test case segregation. Introduced AI-assisted refactoring workflows in the IDE, reducing testcase file rewrites from 1-2 hours to ~15 minutes.
  • Leading the technical collaboration with an external SaaS vendor to build an MVP for a new platform vertical; currently overseeing technical scoping, milestone planning, and delivery tracking.

• Actively collaborated with cross-functional teams, participated in end-to-end feature development, and took ownership of design, implementation, and performance tuning.
  • Designed and delivered the backend of the GoPilot driver-facing mobile app for road-mode tracking, built within a single quarter for a strategic UAE client. Designed authentication middleware, geofencing logic, and core tracking flow.
  • Improved ETL pipeline performance by ~30% in the transform layer, handling 30+ records/sec, each triggering 100+ model-level queries. Refactored pipeline to eliminate N+1 patterns, introduced precomputed derived fields.
  • Drove scalability and observability improvements by introducing SLA definitions and engineering triage dashboards via New Relic. Optimized DB queries by reviewing execution plans and restructuring indexes.
  • Reduced first-response SLA from >24 hours to ~2 hours and mean resolution time from 2-3 days to <1 day by automating client and operations issue assignment and escalation workflows via Slack.

• Demonstrated strong ownership across the full development lifecycle for both features and bug fixes. Designed and delivered scalable logistics and data-driven features in a fast-paced environment.
  • Built geofencing logic using vessel AIS coordinates to trigger container arrival alerts. Developed a detention and demurrage (D&D) cost computation module, leveraging port dwell times and carrier-specific free time policies.
  • Automated container ingestion pipeline by extracting container numbers from PDF attachments in emails using OCR (AWS Textract). Integrated SFTP clients for batch data transfer and webhook-based triggers for real-time updates.
  • Bypassed sliding image captchas from carrier websites using image processing techniques. Introduced mouse movement emulation in Selenium / Ferrum to simulate human interaction and evade bot detection.
  • Maintained Docker-based legacy services on client servers for a key enterprise client.

• Introduced categorization of carriers based on their performance and update frequency for visibility on the client dashboard, reducing client queries about data lag by 70%.
  • Integrated APIs of multiple global shipping lines, increasing coverage by 300% and 3rd-party logistics vendors, adding support for air tracking.
  • Built normalization layers to standardize disparate tracking data into internal schemas.
  • Scripting done for the sampling process for the data quality of data integrated with carrier and third-party vendors.

• Developed an intelligent CAPTCHA breaker to be used as a pre-filling tool in application forms. Applied morphological techniques, de-skew letters and transformed into a processing pipeline.
  • Developed a continuous learning module for new incoming data and fine-tuned the pre-trained model and its integration along with the inference pipeline into the existing Flask microservice.
